title: Indexed eligible pages
definition: Indexed URLs in the verified property, reconciled against the eligible sitemap. This is not the number of generated pages.
target: Resolve accidental exclusions; no promise to index every reference page.
decision: Investigate mismatched canonicals and low-value eligible pages.

title: Active paying customers
definition: Unique customers with an active paid entitlement at the period end. Registered accounts and email subscribers do not count.
target: Validate repeat value before setting a acquisition target.
decision: Observe retention, support load and product usefulness.

title: Recurring subscription revenue
source: Billing MRR report with currency normalisation
definition: Monthly recurring revenue for active recurring subscriptions, excluding one-off buying passes, taxes, unpaid trials and refunds. State currency conversion method.
target: Positive retained revenue with affordable service cost.
decision: Separate recurring demand from one-time purchase demand.

title: Paid customer churn
definition: Customers whose paid entitlement ended during the month divided by paid customers at the beginning of that month. State reactivation treatment; do not mix cohorts.
target: Establish a baseline; investigate reasons rather than inventing a threshold.
decision: Improve usefulness or change the offer before expanding acquisition.

title: Actual AI provider cost
definition: Attributed billed model usage for the same period and MotorJury workload, with currency and allocation method stated. Quota reservations are not cost.
target: Stay within a deliberate spend cap while measuring answer usefulness.
decision: Change quotas, retrieval or pricing when service margin is unsustainable.

title: Actual advertising revenue
definition: Finalised earnings for the selected property and period in USD, with adjustments and currency method stated. Estimated earnings and scenario RPM do not count as finalised revenue.
target: Approval, consent and reader value precede a monetisation target.
decision: Compare finalised revenue with service and content cost before expanding ad load.

title: Free-to-paid conversion
definition: Eligible free accounts in a stated cohort that obtain a paid entitlement within the stated follow-up window divided by eligible free accounts in that same cohort. Exclude internal tests; do not divide cumulative payments by current visitors.
target: Establish a genuine pilot cohort before choosing a target.
decision: Compare the buying pass and recurring offer on usefulness, conversion and retained value.

title: Actual subscription contribution
source: Billing receipts and attributed service-cost report
definition: Subscription receipts net of refunds and processor fees minus attributed paid-service AI, support and stated operating costs for the same period. State allocation method; MRR is not cash and unallocated free-tier costs must remain visible.
target: Positive measured contribution without weakening reader outcomes.
decision: Fix service costs or offer value when each paid customer loses money; do not confuse receipts with profit.

title: Organic search impressions
definition: Impressions for motorjury.com in a settled reporting window, compared with the preceding equal window. Use the same search type, property and filters as organic clicks. Exclude the latest incomplete days.
target: Establish a verified baseline for eligible content.
decision: Separate lost visibility from changes in search-result click-through.

title: Recorded GA4 users · consented measurement
definition: GA4 users observed in the stated report window and property. Analytics loads only after explicit opt-in, so this is not a count of every site visitor. New and returning user counts can overlap and must not be added.
target: Verify collection and exclusions before comparing periods.
decision: Evaluate measured audiences while stating consent and blocker limitations.

title: Recorded GA4 sessions
definition: Recorded GA4 sessions for the same consented measurement scope and dates as the users report. Search Console clicks and GA4 organic sessions use different definitions and coverage; neither should be substituted for the other.
target: Report channel mix with sample counts.
decision: Use measured acquisition sources to evaluate reader journeys.
